small_guidance: The GELU kernel uses a tanh approximation but GPT-2's NewGELUActivation also uses tanh approx — verify formula matches exactly (0.5*x*(1+tanh(sqrt(2/pi)*(x+0.044715*x^3)))). The numerical mismatch (~0.036 avg) suggests the issue is elsewhere: TritonConv1D's matmul may have precision issues with fp32 accumulation when input is fp16/bf16, or the model dtype isn't being respected. Ensure triton_matmul handles the dtype of GPT-2 weights correctly and that c is allocated in the same dtype as a. Also check that bias broadcasting in matmul_kernel uses the correct offsets.
large_guidance: Redesign: the replace_modules pass replaces both Conv1D and nn.Linear, but GPT-2's lm_head is tied to wte embeddings — replacing it with TritonLinear may break weight tying or operate on wrong shapes. Skip lm_head replacement or handle it specially. Also, consider only replacing Conv1D (the heavy attention/MLP projections) and leaving the final lm_head as PyTorch matmul, since correctness errors of ~0.04 across all 5 trials indicate a systematic per-layer drift consistent with an incorrect matmul on one of the projection paths. Alternatively, use tl.dot with allow_tf32=False for stricter fp32 accumulation to rule out TF32 precision loss on the 4090.
